title: Strafing Gunship
text: This unit can attack units in the ground arena. While this unit is attacking a ground unit, the defender gets –2/–0.
rules:
If an enemy space unit has Sentinel, Strafing Gunship cannot attack non-Sentinel ground units. Enemy ground units with Sentinel do not affect Strafing Gunship’s ability to attack ground units.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Defender” becomes “defending unit”.
